consequence.statement: L7 network policies with terminatingTLS will no longer load ca.crt from secrets by default, preventing Envoy from incorrectly requiring client certificates; environments relying on the old behavior must set --use-full-tls-context=true.
consequence.remediation: If the old behavior is required for compatibility, set --use-full-tls-context=true when running cilium

original.statement: L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key from secrets by default; set --use-full-tls-context=true to restore the old behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-b5190a359c10] says that L7 policies with terminatingTLS no longer load `ca.crt` from the secret. It calls the old behaviour, where Envoy required client certificates from pods, incorrect, and says `--use-full-tls-context=true` keeps it only for bug compatibility. Traffic keeps working; only how Envoy handles client certificates changes. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) fits, and the conditional remediation matches the evidence.
